# SaladWorks Menu & Prices 2026 — Full Context Guide

This document contains the complete structured information of SaladWorksMenu.us, designed for consumption by LLMs, search engines, and AI agents.

---

## 1. About SaladWorks
SaladWorks is America's leading fast-casual salad chain, established in 1986. They specialize in fresh, made-to-order salads, wraps, melts, soups, and Pick 2 combos.

---

## 3. Catering Packages (2026 Prices)
- **Basic Catering Package (Serves 10)** — $89.99
  Includes: 2 large signature salads, 10 assorted wraps, 2 choices of soup, and assorted beverages.
- **Party Catering Package (Serves 25)** — $199.99
  Includes: 4 large signature salads, 25 assorted wraps and melts, 4 choices of soup, sides, and beverages.
- **Corporate Catering Package (Serves 50)** — $379.99
  Includes: 8 large signature salads, 50 assorted wraps and melts, 6 choices of soup, 4 sides, and premium beverages.

## 5. Active Promo Codes (Deals)
- **FRESH20**: Get 20% off your entire order storewide.
- **PICK2SDAY**: Get $2 off any Pick 2 Combo meal.
- **SWPERK0214**: Buy 2 Signature or Premium salads for $20.
- **10SALADS**: Get $10 off storewide.
